description: This Java source file defines the ClusterStatusStage class, which creates an Akka stream graph to retrieve and process cluster status information, determining if the cluster is healthy based on reachability and expected roles, and emitting either the count of instances or a rejection decision.

classes.name: ClusterStatusStage
classes.description: Provides a static method to create an Akka stream graph that retrieves and processes cluster status, emitting counts or rejection decisions based on cluster health.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a cluster status stage graph that triggers on messages, retrieves cluster status, and outputs either the count of instances or a credit rejection decision.

methods.name: getPersistenceInstances
methods.description: Determines whether all cluster members are reachable; if so, counts members of expected roles, otherwise returns a rejection.

methods.name: areAllMembersReachable
methods.description: Checks if the cluster status reports no unreachable members.

methods.name: countMembersOfExpectedRoles
methods.description: Counts reachable members of expected roles; if all roles are present, returns the sum, otherwise returns a rejection.
